toolResultCaptureMaxBytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of a tool result recorded into run stats and eval results (default 8192). Caps what is RECORDED, not what the model receives (builtInTools.<tool>.maxOutputBytes / maxBytes) and not what is drawn (toolOutputPreviewLines). A longer result is cut on a character boundary. 0 is rejected: it is not "unlimited" — set a large number instead.

evalToolCoverage.description: Run-level tool-coverage floor for gth eval, graded against the run aggregate rather than any suite's own tool_coverage.min. min is a percentage (0-100) of the post-waiver denominator; waive lists tool-name patterns removed from that denominator. Absent means the run has no floor.
